messages.content: My insurance just rejected the test strip claim. Says it's not approved. How am I supposed to check my blood sugar?

Hey pt-1002. I hear you—that's frustrating. I can't work with insurance claims or arrange refills myself, but I can escalate this to our nursing team. They've got better tools for this stuff. Fair warning: they're running about 31 hours for a response right now. Want me to?
Yeah do it. I have readings from this week though if that helps.
Absolutely, go ahead and share them—I'll log them for your chart. The nurses will take it from there on the insurance side. That's really their wheelhouse.
BP was 138 over 84 yesterday, glucose 156 this morning.
Got those logged. Escalating you to nursing now—they'll reach out within a day with options. One quick thing: we've got your next check-in on [date]. Still work for you?
You got it. Sit tight—the team will help sort this out.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
